def kth_largest(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """
    Returns the k-th largest element in an unsorted list using a Max Heap approach.
    Time complexity is O(n + k log n) due to initial heap construction and k extra deletions.
    """
    import heapq

    # Create a min-heap with the k largest elements
    min_heap = []
    
    for num in nums:
        heapq.heappush(min_heap, num)
        if len(min_heap) > k:
            heapq.heappop(min_heap)

    # The root of the min-heap is the k-th largest element
    return min_heap[0]
